# Obsidian Boom

Obsidian Boom is a light theme modeled on Roam Research, aimed at a block-oriented look and readable typography. Its recorded description applies Roam-like styling to notes and UI elements alike.

![Obsidian Boom screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sainadhx/obsidian-boom/HEAD/roam-1.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Obsidian Boom"
    author: "sainadhx"
    repo:   "sainadhx/obsidian-boom"
    slug:   "obsidian-boom"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/obsidian-boom"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sainadhx/obsidian-boom"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sainadhx/obsidian-boom/HEAD/roam-1.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a Roam Research–inspired light theme to Obsidian for a clean, block-oriented look and readable typography. Bring Roam-like styling to notes and UI elements for a familiar, distraction-minimized writing experience."
}
```
